where: Midday in the great hall of the Old Grand Library: bookcases two storeys high with a gallery round them, saints in stained glass, a painted vault and a dome over the crossing, a red rug under it, lecterns down the sides. The party stands just inside the entrance. Sister Danica has come to them from beside a reading table where a young acolyte writes. At the far end a red door under a balcony leads to the private archives, where the archivist keeps out of sight by a locked glass cabinet.
